findings.passage: Measures like this helps strengthen public trust, improve accountability, and ensure safeguards are in place,
findings.note: Quote attributed to her in her House news release on House passage of Senate Joint Resolution 10, which would put the existing photo ID requirement for in-person voting into the state constitution on the November 2026 ballot. The release also quotes her as saying recent polling shows overwhelming public support for the proposal (only the start of that sentence was returned: "Recent polling demonstrates overwhelming public support for this proposal because it provides the kind of protections").
